title: Rat gastrocnemius, 8 weeks endurance training vs human muscle, 3.5–4 h after endurance exercise
text: Converting the rat signature to human genes kept only clean 1:1 orthologs present in L1000, losing 36% of the 573 significant rat genes. Across all 29,680 compounds the two rankings correlate at r = -0.20, and 0 of the top 100 compounds are shared (r = 0.21 against the human 24 h signature).
caveat: The rat data are 8 weeks of training and the human data a single bout, so this difference mixes species with acute-versus-chronic exercise. It measures how much the drug list depends on the starting signature, which is the assumption earlier rodent-based screens left untested.
